activity_title: Unified ONE uploader for master + all Portfolio Holder dashboards
activity_summary: Rebuilt refresh_ph_dashboards.py into a single production upload workflow that publishes BOTH the master dashboard (leakage_dashboard.html as task_id WLSP_Bietrick_Leakage_Dashboard-V1, located ONLY by task_id, never id=8) and every dashboard/portfolio_holders/*.html. Assigned User and Task ID are derived from the filename (no hardcoded PH names); the default ignore list was removed so abinayaa is included every run. Upsert by task_id: existing row UPDATEs only html_content + updated_at; missing INSERTs full metadata with PostgreSQL-generated id. HTML stored byte-exact via a bound parameter (plain UTF-8; never executed, parsed, compressed, or base64). Continue-on-error with an end summary.
evidence_refs: one uploader; 25 dashboards; task_id lookup; INSERT-new/UPDATE-existing
reusable_pattern: One upsert path keyed by task_id serving master + entities; filename-derived identity; bound-parameter byte-exact upload
validation_rule: Locate row only by task_id; UPDATE touches only html_content+updated_at; verify octet_length and md5 equal source
gap_or_risk: none - uploader is production-ready and idempotent

activity_summary: Validated (read-only) the date-window logic in dashboard_refresh_prompt.md. L1/L2/L3 use the previous complete Mon-Sun week via date_trunc(week,CURRENT_DATE) with a strict less-than this-Monday upper bound; L4 = 30 days ending the previous Sunday; L5 = last 3 complete calendar months; report_date = previous Sunday; generated_at = the run date. Confirmed that manual runs on any weekday (Tue-Sun) and the scheduled Monday 08:45 run BOTH resolve to the previous completed week, and the current partial week is never included. Every checked item PASS.
evidence_refs: all window checks PASS; run Tue 2026-06-30 gives window 2026-06-22..2026-06-28
reusable_pattern: Anchor every window to date_trunc(week,CURRENT_DATE) so an off-day run still reports the previous complete Mon-Sun
validation_rule: Reporting window must be the previous complete Mon-Sun; never include the current partial week
gap_or_risk: Window is computed on the DB server date/timezone

activity_summary: Reviewed the generator for unattended cron (no code changed). Score 40/100. Blockers: it is not standalone - it shells out to the Claude CLI and fetches data via the claude.ai MCP (needs a valid credential); it reads from a different database (project_db at pg.severdigitweb.uk) than the upload target (order_management_copy); LLM-driven generation is non-deterministic and slow; and it lacks retry, atomic master write, an empty-result floor, and an overlap lock. Recommended (not implemented, pending approval): convert the data step to direct psycopg2 against order_management_copy, whose source tables (ppc_performance, order_transaction, order_shipping_billing_detail, amazon_returns) are verified present.
evidence_refs: readiness 40/100; source tables present in order_management_copy; generator uses claude MCP
reusable_pattern: Uploader (direct DB) is cron-safe; generator should be converted to direct SQL to remove the Claude/MCP dependency and DB mismatch
validation_rule: A generated dashboard could be built from a different or stale DB than the publish target; generator not cron-safe until converted to direct SQL
gap_or_risk: Convert generator to direct psycopg2 and add retry, atomic-write, empty-floor, and lock (awaiting approval)

activity_title: Configured weekly Linux cron (Mon 08:45) with logging and best practices
activity_summary: Prepared the weekly cron job (45 8 * * 1): cd project root, run refresh_dashboard.py, and only on success run refresh_ph_dashboards.py, appending stdout+stderr to logs/wlsp_refresh.log. Created the project logs/ folder. Verified project root, python (/usr/bin/python3), psycopg2, and that claude lives at /home/led-247/.local/bin (not on cron default PATH) so the crontab sets PATH and CLAUDE_BIN. Documented install (crontab -e), verify (crontab -l plus psql checks for master, all PH, and new-PH auto-insert), manual test, log monitoring, troubleshooting, and best practices (flock overlap lock, logrotate, ~/.pgpass, absolute paths). No project code, HTML, SQL, or database rows were modified in this step.
reusable_pattern: Chain generator and uploader with logical-and; env (PATH/CLAUDE_BIN) at top of crontab; flock lock; logrotate; credentials via ~/.pgpass
validation_rule: Cron log must show a weekly run; master + all PH updated_at = run date; new-PH auto-inserted
gap_or_risk: cron PATH lacks ~/.local/bin (claude) - fixed via PATH/CLAUDE_BIN
